description: This file defines the ivschatClient class, a client for interacting with the Amazon Interactive Video Service Chat (IVS Chat) service in the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for operations such as creating and deleting chat tokens, logging configurations, rooms, and managing tags.

classes.name: ivschatClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon IVS Chat service, extending the base AWS client.

methods.name: createChatToken
methods.description: Creates a chat token for a user to join an IVS Chat room.

methods.name: createLoggingConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a logging configuration for IVS Chat.

methods.name: disconnectUser
methods.description: Disconnects a user from a chat room.

methods.name: getLoggingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves details of a logging configuration.

methods.name: getRoom
methods.description: Retrieves details of a chat room.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a specific resource.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Sends an event to a chat room.
